whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Basant Bahar,

I noticed your restaurant has been serving customers around New Market Station Rd in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table bookings and online food orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order booking, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/basantbahar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Basant Bahar team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Basant Bahar) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

[Branch A - Checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital food menu, direct WhatsApp ordering, and instant directions for customers in New Market Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?
[Branch B - Not Checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
